# Dilated

> Dilated is a free, MIT-licensed menu bar app that keeps a Mac awake for a set time or until you stop it. It is a public beta for macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon, from CodesWhat. It also has a command line tool, URL automation and AppleScript, and an experimental closed-lid mode that uses a narrow sudo rule you install once with an administrator password.

Dilated is distributed as a notarized Developer ID build outside the Mac App Store. Install it from the website download or with Homebrew: `brew install --cask codeswhat/tap/dilated`.

## Get it

- [Download the latest build](https://dilated.app/download/file): signed, notarized DMG for Apple Silicon
- [Installation and removal](https://github.com/CodesWhat/dilated/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md): Homebrew and DMG install, checksums, uninstall
- [Releases](https://github.com/CodesWhat/dilated/releases): release notes, DMG, ZIP, source archive and checksums

## Use it

- [Automation](https://github.com/CodesWhat/dilated/blob/main/docs/AUTOMATION.md): command line, URL scheme and AppleScript
- [Product page](https://dilated.app/): what it does, with an interactive menu preview

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/CodesWhat/dilated): source code and issues
- [Architecture](https://github.com/CodesWhat/dilated/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): how the app and its closed-lid sudo rule fit together
